question: Give the full name and contact number of members who had to spend more than average on each expense.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.full_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.full_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.expense_description IN (
    SELECT expense_description
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY expense_description
    HAVING AVG(cost) > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
)

Return distinct member full_name and phone for members linked to any expense row in those qualifying expense_description groups.

member.phone is the physical contact-number column in current schema and observed values are phone strings.

expense.cost is the REAL cost measure used in historical AVG(cost) computations.
Question says 'more than average' without restricting to a member or category, so the reference population is all expense.cost values.

scope_obligations: Eligible members: members with at least one expense whose expense_description belongs to a category whose average cost exceeds the overall average cost.
